create.subCreate: Fill in what you need. Sections you leave alone keep their defaults.
create.subEdit: A chat that is running keeps the version it started with. Its next turn uses the new one.
create.previewNew: The agent this form will save.
create.previewEdit: The agent this form will save, and how it differs from the saved one.
create.configNote: The definition this form will save.
create.noChanges: No changes. The form matches the saved agent.
create.allNew: A new agent: every value you set is new.
create.grantsNoticeTitle: Some messaging features will turn off.
create.grantsNotice: This agent had no permission list, so it kept these on its messaging connections: {{grants}}. They stop working until you tick them here.
create.name: Name
create.descriptionHelp: One line that says what the agent is for. It shows in the list.
create.modelHelp: Leave it empty and a chat with this agent uses the model you pick in the chat. Set one to fix it.
create.instructionsHelp: What the agent always follows. Every chat with it starts from this text.
create.collectionsHelp: The collections a chat with this agent may search. The list is exact: an empty list grants none.
create.skillsHelp: The skills a chat with this agent may read. The list is exact: an empty list grants none.
create.addonsHelp: The add-ons whose tools a chat with this agent may use.
create.noAddons: No add-on offers tools to a model.
create.mcpHelp: The MCP connectors you defined and the MCP servers of the fixed model. Switch on the ones a chat with this agent may use.
create.exportHelp: Download the definition of this agent as a JSON file. It holds no id, no dates and no secrets. Import it on another instance from the agents list.
create.importNew: Imported from an exported agent. Read the form, then save.
create.importLegacy: Imported from the export of an older agent. Name, description, model, instructions and skills were read; the rest has no counterpart here.
create.network: Network of commands in unattended runs
create.networkHelp: When a trigger or a connector runs this agent, its commands reach this much of the network, up to the limit an administrator set. A run never asks: a host outside it is blocked. A chat you start with this agent starts with it too.
create.toolsHelp: Choose what a chat with this agent can use, from three sources: tools LocalAI serves, add-ons and MCP servers. A tool that is off is never offered to the model. With no option ticked, the agent keeps the defaults it had on its messaging connections; once you tick any, only the ticked ones work.
create.skillsLater: A chat with this agent reads only the skills that are on.

grantNames.triggers_run: Let triggers start from messaging apps

create.memoryOffUser: Memory is off in your settings, so this agent reads and saves no notes, whatever you set here.

preset.label: Tool level
preset.current: Level: {{name}}. Change a switch below and it becomes a custom mix.
preset.custom: Custom mix of switches. Pick a level to replace it.
preset.appliedBody: The switches below changed. Nothing is saved until you save.

readonly.title: Look only
readonly.body: Searches the web and your collections. No files, no commands, no triggers.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.body: Adds saved agents, triggers and suggested changes. No files, no commands.

full.title: Full
full.body: Every tool the server lists. Sensitive rights stay off.

tpl.appliedBody: The name, description, instructions and tools changed. Nothing is saved until you save.

connections.messagingNone: No messaging connection uses this agent yet. Save the agent, then add one.
connections.messagingHelp: Messaging connections are set on their own page.
connections.chosenHelp: Chats of this agent may use only the ticked connections.
connections.perChat: None ticked: each chat chooses its own.

eff.unsaved: This list follows the form as it is now, including changes you have not saved.

eff.fixOpen: Open the page that fixes it

model.any: Uses the model picked in each chat.

tools.none: No tools are on. It can only answer from what it knows.
tools.blocked: {{name}} is on but cannot work now. {{reason}}

skills.withAddons_one: Can use {{count}} skill that comes with an add-on: {{names}}.
skills.withAddons_other: Can use {{count}} skills that come with add-ons: {{names}}.
skills.addonOff: The skill {{name}} is on, but its add-on {{addon}} is off, so it does nothing. Switch the add-on on.

files.folders_one: Can reach only the {{count}} folder you chose.
files.folders_other: Can reach only the {{count}} folders you chose.
files.none: Cannot reach any of your files.

grants.parentOff: {{name}} is allowed, but it cannot work while {{parent}} is off. Turn {{parent}} on.
grants.connection: {{name}} is allowed for the agent, but not on this connection: {{connection}}
grants.unattended_one: When nobody is watching, it may use {{count}} right on its own: {{names}}.
grants.unattended_other: When nobody is watching, it may use {{count}} rights on its own: {{names}}.

memory.userOff: Memory is off in your Settings, so this agent reads and saves no notes, whatever it chooses here.
memory.none: Memory is off for this agent. It reads and saves no notes.
memory.mine_and_own: Reads your notes and its own, and saves to its own.
memory.own: Reads and saves only its own notes.
memory.mine: Reads your notes and saves to them.
memory.asBefore: Memory works as before: it reads notes when an add-on names Memory.

level.ask: Saves notes (asks first): each note waits for you to confirm it.
level.always: Saves notes, but every note waits for you, and nothing loosens that.
level.never: Reads notes but saves none: your save level is Never.
level.agentAuto: Saves notes at once and tells you, with an Undo. This is the agent's own choice.

memory.connectionLimit: Notes are not saved on these messaging connections: {{names}}.

connections.unsaved: Not used in messaging apps yet. Save the agent, then add a connection.
connections.none: Not used in any messaging app.
connections.error: Could not check {{name}}. Open it to see its permissions.

addons.noConnection: {{name}} is on but cannot work now: you have no account for it. Add one.
addons.stale: {{name}} is on but cannot work now: the accounts saved for it are gone. Pick an account.
addons.pick: {{name}} is on but cannot work now: no account is chosen. A run with nobody there gets none of its tools.
addons.resourcesNone: {{name}} is on but cannot work now: no {{noun}} is ticked.

mcp.ignored: {{name}} is in the agent's MCP servers, but nothing by that name is defined, so it is ignored. Remove it.

try.title: Try this agent
try.desc: Send a message to a test chat that uses the settings in this form. Nothing is saved.
try.noModel: No chat model is installed. Install or pick a model first.
try.defaultModel: No model is set, so the test uses {{model}}.
try.skipped: The test does not use: {{what}}. Those belong to a saved agent.
try.label: Message to the agent
try.placeholder: Ask something this agent should handle
try.deleted: The test chat is deleted when you close this panel.
try.slow: The agent is still working. Stop it or close the panel.

uses.presetNote: A level sets the built-in tools and permissions only. Add-ons, accounts, MCP servers and skills stay as they are.

builtins.title: Built-in tools
builtins.lead: Served by LocalAI. Options sit under their switch.

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.lead: One row each: switch it on, pick the account it uses, see what it offers.
addons.gone: Granted, but not installed or not available to you. Switch it off to remove it.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.lead: Servers outside LocalAI. Their tools may cost money or reach other systems.
mcp.none: No MCP connector is defined yet. Add one on the MCP connectors page.
mcp.server: An MCP server of the model.
mcp.unknown: Not defined: nothing by this name exists, so the agent ignores it.
mcp.unverified: The model is chosen in each chat, so this name is checked there.

now.label: Right now:
now.off: Off. Nothing from it is offered.
now.offKept: Off. Nothing from it is offered. Accounts kept for later: {{names}}.
now.noAccountNeeded: On. Offered: {{tools}}. It needs no account.
now.only: On. Offered: {{tools}}, using {{names}}, your only account.
now.usingMany: On. Offered: {{tools}}, using {{names}}. The model names the account in each call.
now.pick: On, but no account is chosen. A chat asks you to pick one before it gets any tool; a run with nobody there gets none. Tick the account to use, above.
now.noConnection: On, but you have no account for it yet, so none of its tools are offered. Add an account, above.
now.stale: On, but the accounts saved for it are gone, so none of its tools are offered. Tick an account, above.
now.resourcesNone: On, but no {{noun}} is ticked, so it can use none. Tick one, above.
now.resourcesRead: On. Offered: {{tools}}, on {{n}} ticked {{plural}}, read only. Tools that change data cannot run.
now.resources: On. Offered: {{tools}}, on {{n}} ticked {{plural}}; it may change {{w}}.

res.heading: Which <n>{{plural}}</n> it may use
res.error: The list could not be read.
res.empty: You have no <n>{{plural}}</n> to give yet.
res.none: None ticked: it can use no <n>{{noun}}</n>.
res.some: Only the ticked ones. You still need your own access to each.

folder.allHelp: Chats with this agent can reach all your files, as a chat without an agent can.
folder.help: Chats with this agent see only this folder and their own chat folder. Shared folders and skills stay readable. MCP servers and web tools you grant are not limited to this folder.
folder.commands: Commands of this agent run only in an add-on that isolates them, never directly on this machine.
folder.nextMessage: A change applies from the next message of each chat.
folder.missing: This folder is gone. Choose another folder to use this agent.
folder.unset: No folder is chosen yet. Choose a folder to use this agent.
folder.needsChoice: Choose a folder, or pick All my files.
folder.dialogText: Open the folder this agent works in, then use it.
folder.exportNote: The file names the folder {{path}}. Where you import it, the agent gets the folder with that path, if there is one, or asks you to choose one.
folder.effectiveRead: Inside a folder that can only be read, so this one can only be read.
folder.effectiveWrite: Inside a folder that can be changed, so this one can be changed too.
folder.notMounted: {{n}} shared folders do not fit the access limit of a chat and are not mounted.
folder.exportNoteMany: The file names {{n}} folders. Where you import it, the agent gets the folders with those paths that exist, and asks you to choose the others.
folder.noneHelp: This agent cannot reach any of your files. Files you attach to a chat stay in that chat. Watching a folder needs file access, so a trigger that watches a folder still starts for this agent but cannot open the files that arrive.
